title: IT Technologist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Global Commercial Office (GCO) Sales Enablement organization delivers technology solutions that enable commercial teams to improve customer engagement, sales execution, and business performance. This team partners with Sales, Service, Enterprise Accounts, and Commercial Operations stakeholders to support CRM capabilities across the Americas region and advance execution excellence through scalable, reliable technology solutions.
  
This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work model. The role collaborates with globally distributed business and technology teams to ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of Salesforce applications and related business processes.
  
  
As a Salesforce QA Analyst, you will support the quality assurance lifecycle for Salesforce solutions that enable commercial business processes across the Americas. This role is responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, release validation, and continuous improvement of quality practices to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business, functional, and technical requirements.  
  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and solution designs to define testing scope and approach.

* Develop and execute test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Perform functional, system, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce solutions.
* Validate Salesforce configuration, security, automation, and custom functionality including Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components, profiles, and permission models.
* Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems using APIs and batch-processing interfaces.
* Log, track, retest, and report defects using Agile delivery and defect-management tools.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release validation, and post-deployment testing activities.
Collaborate with business analysts, developers, architects, product owners, and business users to ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of software testing experience, including 2+ years testing Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud environments.
* Experience creating test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and requirements traceability documentation.
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect-management tools in Agile/Scrum environments.
    
  Nice to Haves:
* Experience testing Salesforce Health Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Salesforce mobile applications.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium or Copado Robotic Testing.
* Experience with Copado or other Salesforce DevOps and release-management platforms.
* Knowledge of healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industry environments.
Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform App Builder, or related Salesforce certification.  

  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.  
‌

This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

**Role Title :** AVP, Mobile Engineer III - AI native (L10)

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.

**Organizational Overview:**

We are looking for a **Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer** with deep expertise in **native iOS engineering** and strong fluency in **Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-assisted software engineering practices**.

This is **not a traditional mobile development role**.

This role combines the expectations of a **senior hands-on iOS technical leader** with the mindset of an **AI-native engineer** who helps define how modern mobile applications are designed, built, tested, and delivered using A

You will lead the design and development of **high-quality, secure, scalable mobile experiences**, while also driving adoption of **AI-powered engineering workflows**, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and technical outcomes across the mobile organization.

You will work at the intersection of:

**Native iOS Engineering + Generative AI + Agentic AI + Developer Productivity + Mobile Platform Leadership**

  
  

**Role Summary / Purpose**

The **Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer** is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and evolution of high-quality iOS applications and shared mobile capabilities. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across application architecture, feature delivery, AI-powered mobile experiences, performance, reliability, security, accessibility, observability, and developer experience.

The role partners closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Android engineers, QE leads, backend engineers, architects, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, and consistent customer experiences. In addition to strong native mobile engineering depth, this role is expected to actively leverage and champion **AI-assisted and AI-native engineering practices** across the software development lifecycle.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Native Mobile Engineering**

* Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of complex native iOS features and platform capabilities.

* Design and build high-quality mobile applications using **Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple’s iOS SDKs**.

Define and

* scalable architecture patterns that ensure maintainability, testability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.

* Build secure, performant, reliable mobile applications with strong attention to accessibility and user experience.

* Integrate backend services using **REST, GraphQL, WebSocket**, and related service patterns.

* Collaborate with backend and platform engineering teams on API contracts, authentication, resiliency, error handling, and service integration requirements.

* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving crashes, performance bottlenecks, networking, concurrency, memory management, and application stability.

* Drive best practices for code quality, automated testing, observability, release readiness, and operational excellence.

* Contribute to reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, shared libraries, and mobile platform foundations.

* Partner with Android engineers to promote consistent mobile patterns, shared standards, and cohesive cross-platform experiences.
  

  

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**

* Integrate **LLM capabilities** into mobile applications to enable AI-powered conversational, search, recommendation, and workflow-driven experiences.

* Build production-quality mobile experiences powered by **Generative AI and AI agents**.

* Integrate AI models and services such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude**, or enterprise AI platforms.

* Implement **streaming responses, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and multimodal experiences** within mobile applications.

* Build and integrate **AI agents and agentic workflows** that improve customer experience or engineering execution.

* Work with technologies such as **MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain**, or equivalent orchestration frameworks where appropriate.

* Design secure AI architectures covering data handling, context management, authentication, authorization, privacy, and governance.

* Help define practical standards for safe, scalable adoption of AI in mobile applications within a regulated environment.
  

  

**AI-Native Software Engineering**

* Actively leverage AI tools such as **GitHub Copilot** and other LLM-based engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical discovery.

* Build AI-powered workflows across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, and code review.

* Explore and develop engineering agents that can interpret Jira stories, analyze codebases, generate implementation plans, and support development workflows.

* Automate repetitive engineering activities using AI agents, developer tools, and intelligent workflows.

* Champion practical AI-assisted engineering practices while maintaining strong engineering judgment, quality, security, and compliance standards.

* Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, coding assistants, agents, frameworks, and developer productivity tools.
  

  

**Mobile Platform, Engineering Excellence & Leadership**

* Help establish reusable AI capabilities and engineering patterns across mobile teams.

* Develop common patterns, APIs, SDKs, frameworks, and standards for AI-powered mobile experiences.

* Improve mobile build and release reliability through contributions to **CI/CD pipelines, build automation, code-quality gates, security scanning, and deployment workflows**.

* Drive mobile observability through crash analytics, performance monitoring, logging, release-health metrics, and rollout analysis.

* Participate in architecture reviews, technical spikes, proof-of-concepts, and design discussions for foundational mobile capabilities.

* Mentor and coach engineers on **Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, architecture, testing, debugging, and technical decision-making**.

* Produce clear technical documentation, including design proposals, implementation guidance, architecture decision records, and operational runbooks.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, PI planning, ART syncs, and cross-team coordination, identifying and escalating technical risks early.

* Contribute to communities of practice, engineering standards, internal knowledge sharing, and developer experience improvements.

**Required Skills/Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and **5+ years** of relevant experience in Information Technology, or in lieu of a degree, **7+ years** of relevant experience in Information Technology.
* Strong hands-on experience in native iOS development, with deep production expertise in **Swift**, **SwiftUI**, **UIKit**, **Xcode**, and **Apple’s iOS SDKs**. Working knowledge of **Android development** concepts, **Kotlin**, and **Jetpack Compose** is good to have.
* Demonstrated experience **designing**, **building**, and supporting production-scale iOS applications.
* Strong understanding of **iOS architecture patterns**, including **MVVM**, Clean **Architecture**, **modularization**, **dependency injection**, and coordinator-based navigation, where applicable. Familiarity with **Android architecture** principles is a plus.
* Strong understanding of **performance, security, testing, accessibility, observability, and release engineering** for mobile applications.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with **RESTful APIs, microservices, authentication services, API gateway patterns**, and modern backend services.
* Strong knowledge of **Swift concurrency, async/await, actors, GCD, reactive programming, and asynchronous networking**.
* Experience building reusable **iOS components**, frameworks, SDKs, or shared libraries.
* Hands-on experience integrating **Generative AI / LLM capabilities** into software applications.
* Experience with **LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, or AI agents**.
* Demonstrated AI fluency, including productive use of **GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI-assisted development tools**.

* Experience with **CI/CD, build automation, code signing, provisioning, test automation, and release workflows**.

* Strong testing experience including **unit, integration, UI, and automation testing** using tools such as **XCTest and XCUITest**.

* Familiarity with **secure coding practices, static analysis, dependency scanning, and mobile security standards**.

* Working knowledge of **Android architecture and development concepts** to enable effective cross-platform collaboration.

* Strong analytical, **system design**, **debugging**, **problem-solving**, and technical communication skills.

* Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate effectively across teams without direct authority.

* Experience working in **Agile delivery environments at scale**, including **SAFe or similar frameworks**.
* Within the first year, you will help us:
  + Deliver **production-quality AI-powered mobile experiences** on iOS.
  + Establish reusable patterns for **AI-native mobile development**.
  + Lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable **iOS architecture and platform capabilities**.
  + Improve engineering quality and speed through **AI-assisted and agentic development workflows**.
  + Automate meaningful portions of the mobile software development lifecycle.
  + Strengthen standards for **mobile architecture, testing, security, observability, and release engineering**.
  + Improve developer productivity through reusable tooling, frameworks, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  + Help move mobile engineering from **AI-assisted development to AI-native engineering**.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**:

* Experience with both **iOS & Android**.

* Experience with **SwiftUI migration strategies** from UIKit-based applications.

* Experience with **Jetpack Compose** and broader Android mobile patterns.

* Experience with **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude**, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.

* Experience with **MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain**, or similar agent orchestration technologies.

* Experience building **AI agents**, internal developer platforms, or engineering productivity solutions.

* Experience with **mobile CI/CD and build automation** tools such as **Bitrise, Xcode Cloud, Fastlane, GitHub Actions**, or similar.

* Experience with **modular architecture, Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, dependency management, and versioning strategies**.

* Experience with **on-device AI, Core ML, Apple Intelligence, ML Kit, MediaPipe**, or local/edge model execution.

* Experience with service virtualization, API mocking, contract testing, and test-environment management.

* Experience with observability platforms such as **New Relic, Splunk, Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics, CloudWatch**, or similar.

* Experience implementing accessibility aligned with **WCAG and Apple accessibility standards**.

* Experience in **financial services** or other **regulated, security-sensitive environments**.

* Experience working with distributed, cross-shore engineering teams across time zones.

* Experience contributing to communities of practice, standards documentation, and technical forums.

**Key Technologies**

**Mobile:** Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDK, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK

**AI:** LLMs, Generative AI, AI Agents, RAG, Tool Calling, MCP, Agentic Workflows

**AI Platforms:** OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, enterprise AI platforms

**Engineering:** Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, APIs, cloud platforms

**AI Development:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and emerging AI coding/agent platforms

title: Mobile Test Engineer - SDET I
description:
**Mobile Test Engineer**

**ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Associate Analyst**

**About the Role**

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics.

This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.

This role owns quality for the fan-facing mobile experience across Android and iOS. You are the last line of defense before a release reaches fans, and the first person to know when something is not right.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Test Coverage**

* Design, write, and execute manual and automated test cases for new and existing Mobile App features

* Build and maintain automated UI test suites for Android using frameworks such as Espresso or Appium

* Validate API responses and data integrity across content, identity, personalization, and notification features

**Find and Drive Out Defects**

* Log, triage, and track defects through resolution, working with Engineering to reproduce and verify fixes

* Perform regression, exploratory, and smoke testing ahead of App Store and Play Store releases

* Monitor crash reports, analytics, and post-release quality metrics to catch emerging issues early

**Ship as One Team**

* Join sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness reviews to define coverage and acceptance criteria

* Work day to day with Android and iOS Engineering, Product, and Design to clarify expected behavior

* Document test plans, results, and known issues so the team can act on them quickly

**Raise the Bar**

* Improve testing practices, tooling, and automation coverage over time rather than repeating manual effort

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with Android and iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Design, and partners with Product Management on release readiness.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 1+ years of experience in manual or automated testing of mobile applications on Android or iOS

* Experience writing and executing test cases and test plans

* Familiarity with at least one mobile test automation framework, such as Espresso, Appium, or XCUITest

* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

**Preferred**

* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman

* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile app testing

* Experience testing consumer-facing mobile apps in sports, media, or entertainment

**Core Competencies**

* Detail-oriented and methodical about reproducing and isolating defects

* Writes issues engineers can act on immediately

* Comfortable working across Android and iOS in a fast-moving environment

* Collaborative with engineering, product, and design

* Curious about mobile platforms and motivated to improve how testing gets done

**Why This Role Matters**

A single bad release costs fan trust that takes months to earn back. This role protects that, and it is a direct path into deeper mobile engineering and automation work on a product people use every week.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: Mobile Application Test Engineer – AI-Enabled Testing
description:
**Job Description: Mobile Application Test Engineer – AI-Enabled Testing**
==========================================================================

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Experience:** 5+ Years

**About Anblicks**
------------------

Anblicks is a Great Place to Work® Certified™ Data and AI company, helping enterprises build modern data platforms, cloud solutions, and AI-powered applications.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a skilled **Mobile Application Test Engineer** with strong experience in Android and iOS testing, mobile test automation, API validation, and network troubleshooting. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise with **Charles Proxy, device logs, and Appium**, along with exposure to AI-powered testing, LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and compatibility testing of Android and iOS applications.
* Test on real devices, simulators, and emulators across different OS versions and configurations.
* Analyze HTTP/HTTPS traffic using Charles Proxy to troubleshoot API requests, responses, and network-related issues.
* Debug application crashes and failures using Android Logcat and iOS device logs.
* Perform API testing using Postman and validate mobile-to-backend integrations.
* Design test scenarios, test cases, test data, and reusable automation utilities.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot mobile automation frameworks.
* Perform root cause analysis and document defects with supporting logs, screenshots, and recordings.
* Leverage AI tools for test case generation, test automation, log analysis, and defect investigation.
* Validate AI-enabled features for response accuracy, relevance, consistency, and reliability.
* Collaborate with developers, product teams, and QA engineers to ensure release quality.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, test design techniques, defect management, and risk-based testing.
* Hands-on experience with Android and iOS application testing on real devices and simulators/emulators.
* Strong working knowledge of **Charles Proxy**, HTTPS traffic inspection, and API troubleshooting.
* Experience analyzing Android Logcat and iOS application/device logs.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, authentication, and client-server architecture.
* Programming knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Understanding of mobile application lifecycle, permissions, deep links, push notifications, and local storage.
* Experience with Postman, Jira, Git, and Agile methodologies.

**Test Automation & Frameworks**
--------------------------------

* Hands-on experience with **Appium or equivalent mobile automation frameworks**.
* Understanding of Page Object Model/Screen Object Model and reusable framework components.
* Experience with test runners, test data management, reporting, synchronization, and flaky test troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with TestNG/JUnit, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD integration using Jenkins or similar tools.
* Ability to debug, enhance, and maintain scalable automation frameworks.

**AI, LLM, RAG & AI Agents**
----------------------------

* Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted testing.
* Exposure to AI-driven test case generation, test script assistance, and automated defect analysis.
* Knowledge of LLM evaluation, including response accuracy, relevance, consistency, and hallucination detection.
* Understanding of RAG pipelines and testing retrieval accuracy, source grounding, and response quality.
* Familiarity with AI agents, tool calling, API integrations, error handling, and task completion validation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices, data privacy, and prompt injection risks.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or cloud-based mobile testing platforms.
* Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, LLM APIs, or vector databases.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation tools such as RAGAS or DeepEval.
* Knowledge of SQL, mobile performance testing, application security, and CI/CD pipelines.
